annotations.exact_quote: the multi-class models on different K-labelsets are integrated, and a voting based ensemble model is generated to perform the predictions for unseen samples

annotations.exact_quote: the mutual information and joint entropy are adopted to evaluate the redundancy level and imbalance level of each K-labelset

annotations.exact_quote: the randomly selected label set may result in highly imbalanced data for single-label multi-class learning
